feature.label: CB-SEM General SEM V3 Recursive Case Bootstrap

claim.supported_scope: Standard full-ML case bootstrap for the exact CB-SEM General SEM V3 point scope, with at least one recursive structural regression, 500 through 10,000 deterministic indexed no-retry refits, fixed two-sided 95 percent percentile Type-7 inference, and a 90 percent usable-refit gate.
claim.estimand: The empirical case-resampling distribution, sample standard error, percentile interval, and eligible zero-null probability for each supported free loading, regression, covariance, or variance parameter in the exact resident recursive SEM.
assumptions: Rows are independent sampling units and the listwise-complete frame is bound to the resident dataset and Recipe V4.
Every replicate refits the complete ordinary-ML recursive SEM from its exact indexed draw without retry substitution.
Point and bootstrap capability cells, parameter identities, failure ledger, and archive authority remain unchanged through publication.
exclusions: CFA bootstrap, BCa, studentized, basic, one-sided, parametric, residual, robust, weighted, clustered, stratified, multilevel, and Bollen-Stine procedures are excluded.
Feedback, groups, categorical indicators, mean structures, derived rows, explicit constraints, derived effects, conditional probes, and unsupported point-estimation semantics are excluded.
warnings: Standard qualification uses the user-approved streamlined Version 2.50 integration profile and remains limited to the exact registered predicate.
Inference is conditional on the frozen usable-refit threshold; failed attempts remain visible and are never silently replaced.

references.citation: Efron (1979), Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife
Existing validation-only indexed Type-7 and exact-refit bootstrap contract sources

simulations.design: Existing exact-CFA bootstrap interval and ledger sources are reused only as scheduler and arithmetic foundations; recursive structural-SEM coverage remains pending.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario-indexed seeds and indexed draws with every attempted fit retained.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The future Rank 3 evidence report must hash and pass the exact frozen sources; this manifest alone records no passing result.

boundaries.case: Refits are singular, nonconvergent, nonfinite, inadmissible, or below the 90 percent threshold.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Retain indexed failures and publish no inferential result below the threshold.

boundaries.case: The request differs from the exact recursive raw-listwise 95 percent two-sided percentile contract.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Fail closed before estimation without substituting another bootstrap method.

boundaries.case: The same indexed draw ledger is processed in a different worker partition or completion order.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Restored parameter distributions, intervals, probabilities, and failure accounting remain identical.

boundaries.case: The same archive, seed, resample count, and supported worker count execute repeatedly.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The indexed scientific payload is worker invariant apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.

boundaries.case: Any point cell, bootstrap cell, draw index, count, parameter identity, interval, failure, or archive digest is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict validation rejects the result before display, append, readback, or export.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject CFA, point-only, historical, or neighboring bootstrap cells.
Reject altered point, bootstrap, scheduler, interval, or adapter versions.
Reject a changed sampling frame or dataset fingerprint.
Reject stale archive, model, recipe, plan, ledger, or canonical-result digests.
Reject unknown fields, nonfinite arithmetic, missing or duplicate indices, inconsistent counts, or incoherent inference rows.
Never relabel CFA bootstrap or historical preview output as recursive General SEM bootstrap evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: Only newly created general_sem_v1 archives with the exact point dependency and recursive bootstrap cell may own this payload.

applicability_blockers: Missing point or bootstrap Registry cell
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: Every surface must consume the same canonical result for the identical resident archive, indexed draw ledger, complete-model refits, adapter, and exact point-plus-bootstrap cell set.
accessibility_rules: Every interval, count, warning, failure, and unavailable reason has a text and table representation.
Progress, cancellation, and recovery actions do not rely on color or pointer-only interaction.
